# The battle room with everybody ready (FRONTEND.md 11.1: the start grill opening and the START
# button's glow). The clock starts at 1725 and moves 5 ticks a frame: the grill opens one stage a
# frame, START is drawn through light row clock & 31 (29, 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 0, 5, ...).
# Ours:     ta_play <game> --headless --no-sound --no-pointer --frames 10 --shots 0,...,9
#             --net-screen lounge:<this file>
# Original: gui_harness <TotalA.exe> <out> stub:46E000:1:0 clock:1725 main selprov lounge:<this file>
#             clock:1730 frame shot:k1 clock:1735 frame shot:k2 ... clock:1770 frame shot:k9
#           ("frame" runs the interface pass before the room's state, so its kN is our frame N-1;
#           0x46E000 answering 1: every machine's unit definitions compared, START shown;
#           "main selprov" first, as the menus reach the room: they load GUIPAL and make the
#           interface colours the room keeps; without them every interface colour is 0.)
local 0
clock 1725
clockstep 5
map Canal Crossing
players 2

player 0 1 1 0 0 0x1 0x7720 64 0x4 0 5 Host
res 0 640 480
player 1 3 1 1 1 0x0 0x22 2048 0x4 0 5 Prime
